field.name: fabrication
field.doc: 🏭 Fabrication route of a hollow section for the buckling curve of EN 1993-1-1 Table 6.2: hot finished (curve a, a0 for S460) or cold formed (curve c); Unset for sections that are not hollow. A hollow section left Unset has no buckling curve, so its buckling rows stay open.

enum.name: HollowFabrication
enum.doc: 🏭 Fabrication route of a hollow section (EN 1993-1-1 Table 6.2): hot finished or cold formed; Unset for sections that are not hollow.
